steps.name: project-setup
steps.summary: Next 15.5.23·React 19.2.8·TypeScript 5.9.3·Tailwind 3.4.17·Vitest 4.1.10 설치; Vitest domain 프로젝트, src/styles/styles.css 토큰, YAML Vitest inline raw/Next raw-loader+asset/source 구성

steps.name: domain-model
steps.summary: Member/Section/Grid/Story/Project 타입(src/domain/model/member.ts, project.ts), 순수 조회·직렬화 함수와 createSampleProject() 추가

steps.name: rulepack
steps.summary: jp-mlit YAML 룰팩 9개 key(cover.minimum, anchorage.L2, lap.L1, bend.inside-diameter, bend.hook90, bend.hook135, rounding.length, markup.rate, unit-mass.value)와 parseRulePack(files), lookupRule(pack,key,conditions), lookupMarkup(pack,memberClass), lookupUnitMass(pack,size) 구현; RuleHit는 key·label·expr·conditions·value·unit·source·confidence·note 필드 제공

steps.name: rebar-column
steps.summary: Rebar(id·memberId·role·size·shape·points·closed·length·count·rules·formula) 타입과 generateColumnRebar({ member, section, story, beamDepthAbove }, pack) 구현; 主筋은 cover.minimum·anchorage.L2·lap.L1·rounding.length, 帯筋은 cover.minimum·bend.hook135·rounding.length 룰 key를 추적

steps.name: quantity
steps.summary: QuantityLine의 1階|C|C1|主筋 행 ID·부재별 길이/본수·箇所·設計数量/所要数量·RuleHit[] 필드를 집계하고 storySubtotals(), grandTotal(), hasInferred(), inferredRules() 순수 헬퍼를 추가

steps.name: app-shell
steps.summary: src/lib/store.ts의 project·sel·hoverRowId·locale·activeStoryId와 selectMember/selectGroup/setHoverRow/setLocale/setActiveStory/updateProject 액션, useTakeoff(): { rebars, lines, hasInferred, inferredRules }, t(locale,key) ja fallback, src/components/AppShell.tsx의 plan/section/viewer/takeoff 슬롯 및 4페인·고지 구현

steps.name: input-panes
steps.summary: src/components/plan/PlanEditor.tsx·grid.ts와 src/components/section/SectionTable.tsx 추가; spanCoordinates·generateGridMembers·updateProjectSpans로 격자·부재를 재생성하고 selectMember/activeStoryId/sel로 평면·층 탭·단면일람 선택을 연동

steps.name: takeoff-pane
steps.summary: src/components/quantity/TakeoffPane.tsx에 12열·층/그룹/철근 계층과 算出式·出典/inferred UI 추가; 행 ID는 1階|C|C1|主筋, hover는 setHoverRow(line.id), 그룹 선택·자동 스크롤 연동
